verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer a chatbot or natural-language assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only conventional wizards, forms and entity searches, plus probes finding no llms.txt, Markdown docs or OpenAPI spec. Nothing documents natural-language command operation; the rules site's 'word search capabilities' is keyword search, not natural-language control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
